brewery.brewery_description: At your Miramar local, we simply aspire to create the kind of damn fine beer that delivers mouth parties and brings a bit of character. We enjoy spending our waking hours taking a second look at what defines a traditional style, and from there, we give the recipe boundaries a bit of a nudge. Yeah sure it might not please the Purity Police… but actually, we’re good with that.

beer.beer_style: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy

beer.beer_description:
A rascal lives in us all,sometimes big, sometimes small, though sometimes dormant, never extinct. our playful nature is something close to the core and too often forgotten. Go on, make a snowman, give it some devil horns, kick it over and make a snow angel!

Flavours: Fresh, fruity, Gooseberry and citrus with a gentle Red Malt flavour balance.

The Expatriate is an American Pale Ale leaving the homeland in exploration of something more. It had no idea it would find New Zealand but the hops were too good to pass up. An alliance of US and NZ hops are sure to enlist your palate for a second round.

Flavours:Citrus, tropical, floral & pine notes from the hops with a light biscuity malt profile.

Smooth Operator Cream Ale is a light  19th-century American style brew designed to keep you coming back for more. Complete with a slight touch of whole bean vanilla and New Zealand’s finest honey. Think creamy, smooth and refreshing with a clean and zesty finish. Flavours: Lager, Pilsner or Pale Ale Drinker? Welcome to your new favourite style. Some get 1950s Cream Soda… But for adults! Honey, Vanilla, Cornflakes. Not too sweet and no lactose.

Naughty Hopper is packing a mouthful of resinous tropical fruit flavours, thanks to Simcoe, Amerillo and Mosaic hops. These Rockstar hops are low in bitterness but high in juicy goodness. Late additions and awkward positions are what Naughty Hopper is all about.

Flavours: Mango, apricot, and citrus; with a body to back it up.

XPA- Extra Pale Ale. A wise man once said "It's Five O'Clock Somewhere". A Nelson Sauvin/Simcoe duo bring fruity and piny notes witha bit of zing and some mellow, light malts to match. You just need to pull up a seat, kick your feet up after a hard day and Chillax. Meet yous new mini-holiday away from the rat race. 

Flavours: Light malt sweetness for the Nelson Sauvin and Simcoe hops to shine their zingy and fruity heads off.

Does what it says on the tin, mate! Everything you like from a hazy: full flavour, juicy, and all of those delicious tropical notes from dry hopping, without too much bitter

Flavours: Quenching tropical fruits, citrus and lime zest from the US and NZ hops with solid body to match from oats and wheat.

With the wind in your hair, the thrill of the chase, enjoy the crisp satisfaction of your favourite pilsner as you belly up to the bar. The reward for your escape from boring beer is to taste the free spirit of Repeat Offender, the legend of Miramar, whose howls and laughter you can hear from the top of the bike trails to the bottom of each glass. Don't give yourself up without one! 
Flavours: A traditional Pilsner Malt base and Yeast with the dynamic Aotearoa hop duo of Nelson Sav and Rakau.

Our first hazy recipe, she looks innocent but Juicy Two Shoes is rewriting the book on attitude. With pronounced passion fruit and citrus flavours, this hazy New England IPA is bringing the noise like Public Enemy!

Flavours: Per out style, we are using a hefty dry hop to focus on the fruity, juicy goodness here. The lionized Mosaic hops show passion fruit characteristics, while Simcoe provides a lime and grapefruit edge.

You wanted an easy-drinking Lager and we are giving you one. Introducing the "Classic" beer you've been searching for. Quality meets easy goin' beer. No more sacrificing your standards.

Flavours: your standard go-tolager but with the quality ingredients ou would expect from DVB! Think crisp,clean, approachable.

Juice Zilla is our sixth edition in our Juicy- Hazy IPA Series. Coming in with an orchestra of NZ and US hops, expect exactly what the name says: huge flavours of Juicy Hazy goodness!

Flavours: Motueka, Citra and Nelson Sauvin are boldly dry-hopped to keep bitterness down but Aromas and Flavours sky high! Expect massive notes of citrus, tropical, Mojito and gooseberry. We have used Jumbo oats and wheat for body, plus American ale malt and a touch of Pilsner malt for flavour.

Lucy likes to spend all their time with a tropical drink in hand, floating around the Hazy Hop Pools of Planet DVB. To Lucy, life is a relaxed and chill haze. That's why we aspire to be more like Lucy. With heaps of US Hops, we are getting a tropical, juicy, delicious beer with a refreshing body and a crisp finish.

Flavours: Passion and Tropical Juice notes from Mosaic Hops bring a heap of character. Not too bitter and not too sweet. It's like jumping into a lagoon of refreshing hazy juice!

Imagine the most beautiful milk stout in all the land. Now make it with enough flavour for giants: Infuse it with cacao, Flight Coffee and vanilla beans, then cross it with a kick of a Thomson Manuka White Whisky. This isn’t your fairy godmother’s homebrew. This magical tincture is our Magic Bean Stout - a treat for your palate and your belly.

More Malts, More Hops, More Punch! The legend of Mad Eye has been packed into yer glass with all of the aromas and flavours to tell the story. They say there hasn't been a beer to rival the Captain of Hazy Triples across the seven seas. It's delicious aromas and flavours will have ye thinking you're on a sunset cruise but disrespect it and ye will be swabbing the deck!

Flavours: Enter a world of flavours sailed over from US and NZ hops to pickup massive tropical, mango, pine and notes of red apple. Late additions include Mosaic, Motueka, and Riwaka, with bountiful dry-hopping of Superdelic and Mosaic. A big thick hazy base balances the massive flavours to hide the abv and showcase the hops for a punch of flavours enough to drive ya mad!

White Knight will put a bit of pep in your step with delicious Peoples Coffee- Honduras Natural, real Cacao Nibs, Whole-Bean vanilla and a splash of Thomson Manuka-Smoked White Whiskey. 

Once you take a sip you wont believe your eyes when you see it's true colour... Everything you love about a stout but shinning white!

Flavours: Peaoples Coffee- Honduras Natural brings notes of Cola Nut, Cherry and Goji Berry. Cacao Nibs add bold Chocolate flavours, softened by the sweetness of Lactose. Whole Bean Vanilla and some complexity of Manuka-Smoked White Whisky bring a balanced drop to your palate.

Your favourite Cult Classic- Smooth Operator is all grown up and got buff! Think stronger abv to dry it out, plus coconut to mellow on the palate. Malted Maize, Flaked Maize, Oats and Flaked Barley are what makes this beast roar!

Flavours: Coconut, Vanilla & Honey flavours fermented to 7.7% for the perfect balance of warmth, body and sweetness.

"A little nonsense now and then is relished by the wisest men." So take a break and treat yo' self we're nothing like a f****ng elf. They make toys and we make beer, so which one really brings more cheer? You know the answer now and then but might forget if you have ten. 440mls of Porter's Might will bring you chocolate orange delight. 

Flavours: Enjoy a grist of American Ale, Jumbo Oats, Crystal, Light Chocolate, Biscuit, Brown,Munich and Eclipse Malts. Add a dose of Lactose for a touch of sweetness and body. Next, throw in a ton of pureed oranges and cacao nibs. The result is a complex, delicious and moreish treat for the adults in the house.

More Cowbell is a chocolatey sweet stout, enriched with a bit of lactose. Hence the beauty on the front of the can. In the wise words of Christopher Walken “I gotta have more cowbell, baby!”

Flavours: Bringing substantial chocolatey and roasted-coffee flavours, the dark malt shines and brings a sweetness that adds to the creamy texture of milk sugars.
This beer is a celebration of kindness, community and exceptional leadership. We are donating 50% of profits of sales and 100% from the Give a Little page to I am Hope

beer.beer_style: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
beer.beer_description:
Introducing our next-in-line for our Juicy Hazy IPA Series, Naughty Juice. Yep, that's right, all the deliciousness of Naughty Hopper's American Hop Trio, combined with a silky smooth hazy grist heavy in Oats for body and Wheat. 

Flavours: Simcoe, Amarillo and Mosaic are the three heavy hitters that give the Naughty so much resinous tropical fruit flavours. Expect Mango, Apricot, and Citrus; with a body to back it up.

Jumbo Juice comes from a wonderful land of Jumbo Oats growing down in a mystical place called Canterbury… Chuck in a bit of wheat with some massive hops and you get a big bodied, fruity, and zesty Hazy IPA.

Flavours: Azacca, Sabro and Simcoe bring a parade of citrus, coconut, tropical fruit and pine to the show

beer.beer_name: Full Hop, Fresh Hop NZ IPA
beer.beer_description: Huge notes of FRESH Nelson Sauvin bringing gooseberry and fruity notes with a traditional NZ pale ale base. With the majority of the hops added at the end of the boil, the bittering is smooth and the flavours/aromas robust.

This is Judge Juicy. A real beer—from a real brewery—with real ingredients. While the style may be hazy, one thing remains crystal clear... It’s damn delicious. Crack that top, your beer is now in session. 

Flavours: On the bench we find tropical and citrus fruit aromas, making this the Judge of Juicy flavours. We find the brew team GUILTY of adding ridiculously high quantities of Citra, Mosaic and Simcoe in a dry-hopped fashion. Cross-examine this brew to be certain that Justice is Served.

Description - Yet again, a classic DVB bear-beer pun. The goals aside from fun and flavour? We wanted a sour beer that would be just as good for Winter as Summer. Cola seemed like a great direction for an abstract and fun challenge, so we got our thinking caps on and the result is an adult version of that familiar flavour we all know and love!

Flavours - Well, aside from being a sour, which obviously has a bit lower of a PH, we have balanced it with cola flavours and a bit of sweetness from lactose. Think crisp, refreshing and something you'd like to Ice Skate on in winter then thaw out and drink in Summer. Bare with the bear-beer jokes and pour yourself a glass!

Hopunzel
Fresh Hop Belgian IPA - 5.8% ABV
As Fork & Brewer is one of the original craft beer institutions in Wellington and we have been mates for ages, we thought it’s time to have a play on your palate! As champion Small NZ Brewery 2018, and 2019 winners, deciding to work with us is an honour. #owlbeer – Brayden Rawlinson has come on board, and they are entering a new era of fun, funk and fantastic brews. Coming to the plate to create a special collab featuring their in house ardennes yeast, this is a mind expanding brew with notes of tradition and rebellion.

Flavours: Fresh Hop Rakau brings tropical fruit aromas of passionfruit and peach to compliment the esters of the yeast.

This Belgian Tripel is a bold, scandalously traditional classic that refuses to play it safe, holding onto its secrets tighter than a blowing robe on a windy Wellington day. This monk isn’t going to reveal everything until you get it into your glass to breathe a bit. Dry, effervescent, and stronger than it tastes, it is a decadent, high-gravity, relaxed adventure.

Flavours: A straightforward, 100% European Bestmalz Pilsner malt base is lightened with clear candi sugar to keep the body dry and dangerously drinkable at 9.1% ABV. Fermented with WLP530 Abbey Ale yeast, it delivers a deep, spicy ester profile of cherry, plum and pear, while late additions of bitter dried orange peel bring a bright citrus lift. Mild, delicate Saaz hops linger in the background, providing a soft floral touch and a clean bitterness to balance the sweetness.

Tegridy Hops - West Coast IPA - 6.8%

Here at Tegridy Hops, we believe in West Coast IPAs being properly brewed - with tegridy. In a world full of over-complicated, fast-paced nonsense, we have stripped things back to what really matters: honest, hard-working hops and a solid malt backbone. This classic, big, bold West Coast IPA is here to remind you of a simpler time. Whatever you put in your mouth is your business, but if it comes from us, you know we will fill you up down to your belly with tegridy.

Flavours: A robust, classic grist of Ale, Munich, wheat, dextrine, and light crystal malts delivers a rich, balancing sweetness to hold up the heavy hop load. Columbus Cryo brings a modern, punchy bite of dank pine, black pepper, and intense citrus, laying a solid foundation for El Dorado’s bright pineapple notes. Dolcita hops finish the job, bringing a fresh-breed wave of ripe peach, orange, and sweet piña colada character over a clean, dry, and assertively bitter finish.

Ten years of Double Vision Brewing, and we are stripping it back to celebrate! For our decade milestone, we wanted a proper birthday drink that encapsulates the DVB essence in one drop: a classic, sessionable NZ Pilsner built to celebrate with. The character on the can might be keeping things completely bare, but this beer is fully dressed in the best hop profile we could muster. Accessible, inclusive, and built for repeat pints as we toast to ten years of pushing the boundaries.

Flavours: A simple, straw-coloured base of New Zealand Pilsner malt and a measure of wheat keeps the mouthfeel delicate yet soft, letting the hops take centre stage. Fermented clean with Froth Vagabond Czech Pilsner lager yeast, this brew takes you on a three-stop hop tour. Local Kohatu brings fresh tropical pineapple, Australian Galaxy exudes lush passionfruit, and USA Krush Cryo delivers a final punch of tropical fruit cocktail, berry and bright citrus—snappy, dry, and maximum moreishness.

items.badge_description:
Hoppy Hazy IPA Day! 

For the uninitiated, Sierra Nevada had the brilliant idea to create a day of celebration for hazies back in 2023! This year, we’re excited to introduce our third iteration of the Hazy IPA Day badge. 

Whether you call it hazy, murky, blurry, or New England style, let’s raise our glasses to these heavenly hoppy ales!

items.checkin_comment: Sweet Christmas cake. Super smooth on nitro.

beer.beer_description:
Santa may be a Lost Clause, but you’re on the nice list if you’ve got this beer in your vessel. Down here, Christmas lands in summer - so while the big guy’s stuck halfway down a chimney, you can unwrap a sun-season sipper that’s all Christmas cake with no fireplace required.

flavours: A plush barley-and-wheat base carries rich muscovado molasses, toffee, and dark caramel. Festive spice - cardamom, cinnamon, nutmeg, and ginger - builds gingerbread warmth, while dates and raisins layer dense dried‑fruit notes (fig, plum, sultana). Full‑bodied, smooth, and gently warming, with a long, cake‑like finish.

(4th in the Mecha Series)

Fire Horse is a stone-cold killer – in all the right ways. The 4th in our Mecha Series rolls in with massive flavour, big horsepower and rumbling hops, built to be the hottest buy of the month. It’s smooth in the saddle but quick to the kick – careful, it’ll get away from ya.

Flavours: Pilsner malt, wheat malt, rolled oats, flaked wheat and a touch of Gladiator build a dense, pillowy body that keeps the 10.1% riding clean. Nectaron, Citra and Krush pump out fruity, bright, tangy candy notes – pineapple, passionfruit, citrus and juicy tropicals – with soft bitterness and saturated hop oils. Stone cold on the palate, hot property in the fridge.

beer.beer_description:
This year’s Hop Drop is straight dynamite. Hop Drop 2026 keeps the series rolling but flips the script, locking in on bright, tropical lime-driven NZ character. Brewed for Smith’s NZ IPA Challenge and gunning for one thing - the title of best NZ IPA in New Zealand. Same attitude as the earlier Hop Drops, new expression: sharp, modern, and proudly Aotearoa.

Flavours: A light pilsner malt base with a solid dose of wheat, dextrine malt and flaked grains builds a soft, pillowy body that lets the hops detonate. Riwaka brings punchy, bold tropical and citrus. Motueka layers in zesty lime, lemon drop and mojito-like notes. Freestyle’s new Limequat blend fires off fresh tropical lime, citrus and a subtle floral edge. Fermented with WLP008 East Coast Ale Yeast, it pours hazy, drinks juicy, and packs saturated NZ hop flavour from first sniff to final sip.

 but my beers closer.

beer.beer_description:
Brewed with the legends at Third Moon (Canada), Wizardry is more than a shared recipe - it’s a meeting of minds. Our brew teams aligned on style cues and hop obsessions, and both artists created twin renditions of the same artwork, split and aligned for a true inside-and-out collaboration.

Light-coloured grist of Pilsner malt, wheat, and high‑protein flaked malts with maltodextrin and dextrose for a pillowy body that carries 10.6%. Hefty Citra and Superdelic headline whirlpool and dry hop, with Riwaka as the loud friend tying it together—fresh lime, juicy passionfruit and tropicals, lingering grapefruit, sweet citrus/white‑grape softness, soft bitterness, clean finish.

Cut from the same cloth as the original, Wizardry Vol 2 brings the Third Moon x DVB potion back with the dials quietly turned up. Same big hazy collab energy, but tuned for cleaner balance, smoother drinkability and a new hop direction. Less red fruit lolly, more stonefruit and blueberry…
